operations.description: A proposal is an immutable set of notebook changes captured with its exact source revision. This operation captures a proposal from a running persistent editor session and publishes it as a pull request, merge request, or equivalent through the configured source-control provider. Set target_proposal_id to update the change request published by that proposal; omit it to create a new change request. The Idempotency-Key header is required; retry with the same key to resume the same operation. If the error code is PROPOSAL_RETRY_REQUIRED, retry with a new key instead.
